name: How long does the framing process typically take for a standard room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does the framing process typically take for a standard room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the framing process for a room addition varies depending on its size, complexity, weather conditions, and crew size. For a typical single-story room addition, framing might take anywhere from one to three weeks. Larger or more complex additions, such as those with multiple stories or intricate roof lines, could extend this timeline. This estimate does not include the time required for planning, permits, foundation work, or subsequent finishing stages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing for a standard room addition typically takes one to three weeks, depending on size, complexity, and weather.
